title: Offshore Creative Studio for Global Brands · Vibescape
desc: A creative studio for brands worldwide. Branding, product films, ad creative and websites from a senior team in Lahore and Dubai, in your hours.
h1: A creative team for brands anywhere.
lead: Strategy, films, ads and websites from one team in Lahore and Dubai. Agency standard work, studio level costs, and a portal that shows you everything in real time.

points.title: Your hours
points.text: Our day overlaps with UK and European working hours, and US mornings. Calls are booked in your time zone.

points.title: One portal
points.text: Every brief, file, comment and report lives in our Desk. You never have to ask where your work is.

points.title: Clear pricing
points.text: Fixed scopes or monthly retainers, invoiced in USD. You know the cost before we start.

points.title: Real production
points.text: A full crew, studio and post production house, so content is shot properly, not stock.

links.title: For agencies
links.text: White label video, motion, design and web for agencies.

links.title: For ecommerce brands
links.text: Product films, ad creative and Shopify stores.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Pakistan and the UAE?
faq.a: Yes. We work remotely with brands and agencies worldwide, with shoots in Lahore, Dubai or on location.

faq.q: How do we communicate day to day?
faq.a: Through your client portal, email and scheduled video calls in your time zone. Every request and approval is logged in one place.
Projects are quoted upfront and invoiced in USD, with milestones for larger projects.

faq.q: Can you shoot our products if we are abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Many brands ship products to our Lahore studio for shoots, which is often far more cost effective than local production.
